entries.name: Flight hero

notes: Skinned to the shared Mixamo skeleton (22 animated bones). Keep the mixamorig bone names so all 39 baked clips still drive the new mesh.
The suit pattern is painted as vertex colours by the suit painter in archetypes.js; a textured reskin can replace it.

entries.name: Hero skeleton
entries.desc: The single skeleton every hero is skinned to: the standard Mixamo humanoid (mixamorig: names). Shown in its bind pose on the Shapeshifting hero.
notes: All 39 animation clips were baked against these bone names; a reskin that keeps them inherits every animation.
Leg and arm bone offsets are scaled per hero (leg length, shoulder width), so one skeleton fits every build.
Root motion: the hips XZ track is stripped from each clip and applied to the character, so the mesh must not rely on hip translation.
Rig units are Mixamo units; each hero is scaled so its idle stance is 1.85 m × the archetype height.

entries.name: Capes (short, medium, long)
entries.desc: Capes are simulated cloth grids pinned along the collarbones. They collide with a torso capsule and a back plane and trail with movement. Shown from behind on Flight (short), Telekinesis (medium) and Cryokinesis (long).
notes: Width comes from the hero's shoulders; length is a fraction of body height.
Coloured from the suit: primary blended 40% toward secondary.
Short capes: Flight, X-Ray Vision. Medium: Telekinesis. Long: Cryokinesis.

entries.name: Tiered tower

A dark 1.4 m lobby plinth wraps the base. Collider is the footprint, full height.
Downtown blocks hold one or two towers (16% of blocks are plazas instead).

entries.ranges: Footprint 7–11 × 7–11 m; height 9–26 m (tall: 30–48 m, 2–3 tiers, each tier shrinks to 68–82%)

entries.name: Superhero landing impact
entries.desc: The Superhero Landing touchdown: gold and white shockwave rings, a burst of 60 gold particles, screen flash and shake, played over the landing pose. A gold ring also pulses on the ground below the player while they steer the drop.
entries.variants: Single look.
rows: Gold #ffd166 to 9 m over 0.7 s, white to 5 m over 0.5 s

entries.name: Telekinesis grip
entries.desc: While Telekinesis holds a target it floats in a purple haze of rising sparks, with a ring pulsing on the ground every 0.3 s. Held heroes loop a flailing hit reaction.
entries.variants: Single look; also used on lifted props (cars, bins, benches).
rows: 3 m up, then reeled in at 8 m/s and thrown at 27 m/s

entries.name: Flame cone
entries.desc: Pyrokinesis channels a roaring cone of orange flame with yellow cores straight ahead of the hero, incinerating anyone within 8.5 m inside the cone.
entries.variants: Single look.

entries.name: Power aura & shadow
entries.desc: Every hero stands on a slowly spinning, pulsing ring in their power's colour, over a soft round blob shadow. It is the main way to read a hero's power at a distance.
entries.variants: Colour follows the power (one of 10).
rows: Ring 0.55–0.85 m, 55% opacity, spins 1.5 rad/s, pulses ±12%
Disc 0.62 m, 30% black, fades with altitude
